##: Uses upstream's standalone portable executable; no installer is run.
description: Windows network security monitor with per-program traffic analysis, threat alerts, and firewall controls.
notes: Full monitoring and firewall actions require Administrator. Do not enable Start with Windows from this Scoop installation: Kestryl's elevated scheduled task must not target an executable in a user-writable directory. Settings, history, and alerts remain under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kestryl after Scoop uninstall.
